boundary: Retrospective explicit conjectures and scoped rejection attempts. These were not all preregistered conjectures. Imported results are reviewed source evidence, not freshly rerun tests. No failure to find authority is classified as a refutation.

conjectures.statement: The six-arm classifier uniformly identifies interval processes when reference/validation factors may change independently within [1/5,1].
conjectures.verification: Exact identical-distribution counterexample in the frozen finite-sample task.
conjectures.counterexample: True [1,2] with reference factors (1/4,1/2,3/4) and validation factors (25/36,1/2,27/100) aliases stationary [2,3].
conjectures.survives: Static shared-factor theorem remains valid; sufficiently bounded drift is not refuted.

conjectures.statement: The faithful six-object passive process dictionary automatically encodes interval identity in its common-vacuum output.
conjectures.verification: Fresh exact checker and passive vacuum-fixing identity.
conjectures.counterexample: All six distinct E(i,j) process operators fix the same vacuum state.
conjectures.survives: Other specified preparations and calibrated process-probe families are not excluded.

conjectures.statement: A faithful interval-state encoding intertwines repeated L, l or R with the one fixed marker flip without extra control state.
conjectures.verification: Executed exact owner-local checker and written algebraic proof.
conjectures.counterexample: The optical channel squares to identity; the visible m=4 L chain (3,4)->(2,4)->(1,4) does not. Analogous l and R chains differ.
conjectures.survives: Richer controlled optical families are not excluded.

conjectures.statement: Applying A inverse to the final full-port output SAx removes the first round for every input in the retained cavity model.
conjectures.verification: Written operator derivation and direct rational source-code calculation; no fresh cavity execution.
conjectures.counterexample: This would require AS=SA. For A=W0,S=W1, (W0 W1)[1,4]=192/625 but (W1 W0)[1,4]=0.
conjectures.survives: The conditional correction is S A inverse S inverse; physical implementation is unspecified.

conjectures.statement: Deleting a prefix record permits execution of the same detector suffix from initial ready memory without changing its law.
conjectures.verification: Reviewed exact source instrument and history implementation, not rerun.
conjectures.counterexample: After a click, an immediate photon has click probability zero; from ready memory it has probability 9/25.
conjectures.survives: Suffix restriction with the actual inherited boundary state preserves the existing run.

conjectures.statement: A complete computational-basis environment log suffices to recover every unknown input as coherent environment access does.
conjectures.verification: Reviewed ideal-qubit counterexample; no fresh execution or laboratory claim.
conjectures.counterexample: Orthogonal plus/minus inputs give the same half-zero/half-one classical log, while coherent environment access preserves their relative phase.
conjectures.survives: Coherent and actuable environment access can support the ideal inverse dilation.

conjectures.statement: Adding noiseless single-mode ringdown to the steady response identifies mirror return m and internal survival eta separately.
conjectures.verification: Reviewed exact scalar-model factorization and rank result, not rerun.
conjectures.counterexample: Both records depend only on rho=m*eta. (9/10,4/5) and (3/4,24/25) have rho=18/25.
conjectures.survives: An independent calibrated leakage port with a justified mirror law can raise identification rank.

conjectures.statement: Injectivity at every finite cavity parameter supplies a cutoff-uniform recovery margin in a fixed observation window.
conjectures.verification: Reviewed exact family and limiting proof, not rerun.
conjectures.counterexample: Captured unit-input energy is 1-r_n^(2H), tending to zero at fixed H as r_n tends to one.
conjectures.survives: A fixed calibrated plant or separately authorized horizon scaling can have a useful recovery margin.

conjectures.statement: The discrete mirror map, locality, positive quadraticity and vacuum fixing uniquely select the continuous generator at a fixed component duration.
conjectures.verification: Reviewed explicit projector-generator countermodels and written all-sector argument, not rerun.
conjectures.counterexample: h0=(pi/tau)Q and h1=(pi/tau)(Q+2P_active) agree at every integer duration but give opposite half-step field means on the supplied vacuum/one-photon coherent witness.
conjectures.survives: A source-specified continuous primitive family and clock could select the branch.

not_refuted: existence of any optical interval realization
availability of a future calibrated inverse controller
